newsitem.title: USA: Lamcor to be acquired for about $8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lamcor to be acquired for about $8 mln.

text.p: Lamcor Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to be acquired by Packaging Acquisition Corp, an affiliate of POLYFLEX Film and Converting Inc, in a transaction initially providing $4 a share.
POLYFLEX is a privately held packaging company based in Summit, Mississippi.

At the close of the merger, an additional $0.12 for each share of outstanding Lamcor common stock would be deposited with a bank, to be held in escrow for one year to satisfy post-closing claims, if any, by Packaging Acquisition.
Lamcor has 1,932,371 shares outstanding giving the proposed transaction a value of almost $8 million.
At the end of the one-year escrow, and after the payment of any claims and related costs, any remaining escrow funds, plus interest, would be paid to the shareholders of Lamcor on a pro rata basis.
The proposed transaction requires shareholder approval at a meeting to be scheduled.
Lamcor makes, markets and distributes flexible packaging and laminated films for food, medical and industrial applications.
